I posted the list in #strategic-pod as a reply to you. It has seven Vantorre Group entries, each with its source:

1. #8841, Allentown kiosk timeout, Dock Door 12: open as of 5/4/2026 (Moss digest 5/4).
2. #8841, closed with support by Gideon on 7/1/2026 (#strategic-pod).
3. #8841, Newark Dock Door 14 not selectable, escalated to platform engineering: reported 9/30 (Moss digest 9/30).
4. #PD-8841, two missed carrier check-ins at Allentown Gate 4: 4/27 (Moss digest 4/27).
5. #PD-4418, Carrier_Dwell_Summary dropping timestamps at Dock Door 9: 9/15 (Moss digest 9/15). The digest says only "the account Nadia runs," so please confirm it's the parent.
6. INC-4821, Hartford outage, status-page access still open: 8/3 (#inc-vtg-hartford).
7. VT-55120, root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage: 10/14 (#inc-vtg-hartford).

Left out: #4812 (Mobility) and #PD-4402 (Quillfeather). Some parent-level issues have no ticket number, so they aren't in the list.

Before this goes to Mateo, check #8841 in the ticket system. It appears for three different issues, and the 7/1 closure conflicts with the 9/30 digest that reports it as newly submitted. I can't access the ticket system, so I couldn't verify this.
